## Summary

What this pull request changes and why. Keep it short; the details belong
in the code and in the linked issue.

## Related issues

Closes #<issue number> (or "None").

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or chore

## Testing

How you verified the change, for example:

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] Full PS4 build succeeds (`make` with the toolchain set up)
- [ ] Tested on a real console (mention firmware and HEN version)
- [ ] Not applicable (docs only)

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is based on `dev` and targets `dev`
- [ ] One PR, one topic: everything in here belongs to this change
- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional style, in English
- [ ] New code builds clean with `-Wall -Wextra`
- [ ] Comments only where the code is not self-explanatory
- [ ] No unrelated code, unused imports, or variables removed
- [ ] Docs updated when the change affects them
